**Checking Server Logs and SSO Configuration**

Regarding SSO issues, if you encounter an "Invalid redirect URI," check the exact URI in your browser's address bar after selecting the IdP and ensure it matches precisely with the configured URI in your IdP settings. Please send me the provider type, app/client ID, full redirect URI string, and timestamp. If you've changed your app domain or deployed a new environment recently, consider reverting to email/password sign-in temporarily while we verify settings and checking if the allowed callback list was modified.
